name: Ganesh Gayatri
text:
ॐ एकदन्ताय विद्महे वक्रतुण्डाय धीमहि ।
तन्नो दन्तिः प्रचोदयात् ॥
meaning: We contemplate the one-tusked, curved-trunked one. May that presence inspire our understanding.
purpose: A Gayatri-style invocation for insight and wisdom.
note: The client list uses this wording; variations exist.
